overall_notes: The paper focuses on full-duplex spoken dialogue generation using a multi-stage training approach. Evaluation uses both automatic metrics (WER, CER, UTMOS, turn-taking metrics) and LLM-as-judge scoring. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and removal of duplicates. The paper does not conduct human evaluation.
